rename.from: Signal forms - radio input does not reflect form model signal if value attribute is enum
rename.to: Signal forms - radio does not reflect form model signal initial state if value attribute is enum

body:
The bug here is that setting the value via binding is set after the control is updated. 

The workaround for now is having the value binding _before_ the field binding. 

```html
<input
  type="radio"
  [value]="projectStatusEnum.CLOSED"
  [field]="projectForm.status" 
  id="btnradio2"
/>
```

issue.title: fix(forms): Ensure the control instruction comes after the other bindings

issue.body:
Prior to this change, binding to radio value was sensitive to the order in which `value` & `formField` where binding in the template. The compiler change makes that order non-important.

fixes #66402
